referenceFunction.includedProcesses: This dataset documents the production of polymer-modified bitumen containing 3.5% Polybutadiene in Switzerland, following European standards. It includes processes such as bitumen extraction, transportation, and manufacturing. Waste disposal processes are not included in the scope of this dataset.
